question: Should this PR localize gateway JSON message/reason fields, or should those protocol-facing strings stay stable while only display-specific text is localized?
rationale: Repository policy treats gateway protocol and compatibility surfaces as upgrade-sensitive, and source review cannot prove whether downstream clients consume these strings as stable text or display-only copy.

options.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Localize chat/UI display copy but keep gateway JSON message/reason fields stable, or add separate display-localized fields where needed.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Text
options.body: Allow gateway JSON message/reason fields to vary by locale after maintainers confirm stable code/type fields are the only supported client contract.

options.title: Pause Gateway Runtime I18n
options.body: Limit this PR to non-protocol runtime copy until gateway field ownership and client compatibility are documented.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/UI display copy but keep gateway JSON message/reason fields stable, or add separate display-localized fields where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently carried and merged adjacent agent runtime billing behavior that this PR must preserve before the gateway compatibility choice can be safely reviewed.
